use_cases.name: Create a payroll run for a period
use_cases.goal: Create a typed payroll run for an entity, period and payroll group, with its population and inputs assembled from every source.

stakeholders.interest: Starts each cycle from a complete, explainable population and input set.
Can distinguish regular, overtime, arrears, F&F and bonus runs in the journal.
Joiners, leavers and transfers are paid in the right run.

use_cases.trigger: Start of the monthly cycle, or an off-cycle need (overtime, arrears, F&F, bonus).
preconditions: The entity, payroll group and pay period are configured.
Attendance, leave, overtime and claims data for the period are available through their modules.
postconditions_success: A payroll_run exists in DRAFT with its run_type and payroll.run.created emitted.
The population and pulled inputs are listed on the run cockpit with source counts.
postconditions_failure: No run is created, or the run stays DRAFT with the missing input source named.

main_flow.action: Create the run on the run cockpit: entity, period, payroll group and run_type (regular, off_cycle_ot, arrears, fnf, bonus).
Resolve the population: active assignments in scope plus joiners, leavers and transfers within the period.
Pull inputs: attendance days, leave, gate pass, OT, claims, arrears, one-time earnings and recoveries.

alternate_flows.condition: A regular run already exists for the period and an off-cycle run is needed.
steps: The payroll manager creates a second run with the off-cycle run_type against the same period.
The cockpit shows both runs under the period with a run selector.

alternate_flows.condition: An employee transferred between payroll groups mid-period.
steps: The platform includes the employee in each group's run for the days assigned to that group.

exception_flows.condition: An input source has not published its period data.
exception_flows.handling: The run remains DRAFT and the cockpit names the missing source; inputs cannot be locked until it is present or explicitly marked nil.

exception_flows.condition: An active employee has no assignment in any payroll group.
exception_flows.handling: The person is excluded from the population and listed as an exception for the pre-payroll audit.

nfrs: Population and input pull for 10,000 employees completes within 5 minutes.
Every screen that lists runs accepts a period and a run selector.

user_stories.want: to create a run with an explicit run type
user_stories.so_that: a period can carry a regular run and separate off-cycle runs

acceptance.given: PR-2026-09-01 is a regular run for September 2026
acceptance.when: I create a run for September with run_type off_cycle_ot
acceptance.then: PR-2026-09-02 is created in DRAFT and both runs appear under September

acceptance.given: I omit run_type
acceptance.then: creation is refused and run_type is marked required

user_stories.want: joiners, leavers and transfers to be included automatically
user_stories.so_that: nobody is missed or paid twice

acceptance.given: an employee joined on 18 September 2026 and another left on 12 September
acceptance.when: the September regular run is created
acceptance.then: both appear in the population with their in-period dates

acceptance.given: an employee moved from LE-01 to LE-02 on 16 September
acceptance.then: each run includes the employee for the days assigned to it

use_cases.name: Lock payroll inputs and take an immutable snapshot
use_cases.goal: Freeze a run's inputs at cut-off and store a hashed snapshot of inputs, rule pack versions and configuration so the run can be recomputed exactly at any later date.

stakeholders.interest: Late changes cannot alter a run under review.
Any past run can be recomputed and matched to the paisa.
Late punches are handled as exceptions, not silent changes.

use_cases.trigger: The cut-off date and time for the run is reached.
preconditions: The run is in DRAFT with all input sources present or marked nil.
postconditions_success: The run is INPUTS_LOCKED; payroll.inputs.locked and payroll.snapshot.taken are emitted.
The snapshot stores the input hash and rule pack versions.
postconditions_failure: The run remains DRAFT and no snapshot is stored.

main_flow.action: Lock the run's inputs at cut-off on the run cockpit.
Write an immutable, hashed snapshot of inputs, rule pack versions and configuration; emit payroll.snapshot.taken.

alternate_flows.condition: A material input error is found before the pre-payroll audit starts.
steps: The payroll manager returns the run to DRAFT with a reason; the snapshot is superseded, not deleted.
After correction the inputs are locked again and a new snapshot is written.

exception_flows.condition: A punch, leave approval or claim arrives after the lock.
exception_flows.handling: The run is not changed; the item is raised as an exception and flows to the next open run or arrears.

exception_flows.condition: Recomputing a closed run from its snapshot gives a different result.
exception_flows.handling: A CRITICAL integrity alert is raised to the payroll manager and auditor with the differing lines.

nfrs: Snapshots are write-once; no role, including tenant admin, can alter one.
Recomputation of any run up to 8 years old reproduces every payslip line exactly.

user_stories.want: locking inputs to stop late changes from altering the run
user_stories.so_that: the figures I review are the figures that get paid

acceptance.given: the September 2026 regular run is INPUTS_LOCKED
acceptance.then: the run's attendance input is unchanged and an exception names the late punch

acceptance.given: inputs are locked
acceptance.then: payroll.snapshot.taken carries the input hash and rule pack versions

user_stories.want: to recompute a closed run from its snapshot
user_stories.so_that: I can prove the paid figures were produced by the recorded rules

acceptance.given: a run closed eleven months ago
acceptance.when: it is recomputed from its snapshot today
acceptance.then: every payslip line matches to the paisa

acceptance.given: a recomputation differs on one line
acceptance.then: a CRITICAL integrity alert lists the differing line

use_cases.name: Run the pre-payroll audit
use_cases.goal: Detect and resolve every input defect before calculation, using explainable rule checks first, with an agent proposing but never applying resolutions.

stakeholders.interest: Sees a ranked, explained list of defects with draft fixes.
Is not paid wrongly because of a missing UAN or a duplicate bank account.
Every waiver has a reason and a role at or above the threshold.

use_cases.trigger: payroll.snapshot.taken for the run.
preconditions: The run is INPUTS_LOCKED with a stored snapshot.
postconditions_success: Every flag is resolved or waived with reason; no CRITICAL flag is open; the run moves to PRE_AUDIT complete and payroll.audit.completed is emitted.
A signed readiness report is attached to the run.
postconditions_failure: Open CRITICAL flags keep the run from calculation and approval.

main_flow.action: Run the rule checks (missing attendance, unprorated joiner, bank change in cycle, missing PF/UAN, negative net and others); emit payroll.audit.completed.
Classify each flag, draft a resolution and produce a signed readiness report; record each proposal in the action ledger.
Resolve or waive each flag with a reason on the pre-payroll audit screen.

alternate_flows.condition: No flags are raised.
steps: The readiness report states zero flags and the run proceeds to calculation.

alternate_flows.condition: The agent is unavailable.
steps: The payroll manager works the flags without proposals; the readiness report is signed by the payroll manager.

alternate_flows.condition: Statistical checks run after the rule checks.
steps: Per-employee net and component variance outside configured bounds raises WARNING flags.

exception_flows.condition: A user below the role threshold tries to waive a CRITICAL flag.
exception_flows.handling: The waiver is refused; the flag stays open and approval remains blocked.

exception_flows.condition: The agent attempts to change a payroll figure.
exception_flows.handling: The write is rejected at the tool boundary and the attempt is recorded in the action ledger.

exception_flows.condition: An employee's Aadhaar or PAN does not match.
exception_flows.handling: A payroll-blocking flag is raised for that employee only; joining is not reversed.

nfrs: The eleven rule checks complete within 3 minutes for 10,000 employees.
Each flag shows the rule that raised it and the input values that triggered it.

user_stories.want: rule checks to flag defects with the reason before calculation
user_stories.so_that: I fix inputs rather than correct payslips

acceptance.given: an employee in the September run has no UAN
acceptance.then: a CRITICAL 'missing PF/UAN' flag names the employee

acceptance.given: two employees share bank account number ending 4471
acceptance.then: a duplicate bank account flag lists both employees

user_stories.want: the agent to propose fixes that I accept or reject
user_stories.so_that: I save time without losing control of figures

acceptance.given: a mid-month joiner is not prorated
acceptance.then: a draft resolution is shown and no payslip value has changed

acceptance.given: I reject the proposal
acceptance.when: I record my own resolution with a reason
acceptance.then: the action ledger shows the proposal, my rejection and my resolution

user_stories.want: CRITICAL waivers to be limited to the configured role threshold
user_stories.so_that: no one can wave through a blocking defect

acceptance.given: the threshold is Payroll manager or above
acceptance.when: an HR operations user tries to waive a CRITICAL flag
acceptance.then: the waiver is refused

acceptance.given: the payroll manager waives it with the reason 'UAN generation pending with EPFO'
acceptance.then: the flag shows the actor, time and reason

use_cases.name: Execute gross-to-net calculation
use_cases.goal: Evaluate the tenant's pay component graph once per employee in topological order, in integer money, storing every intermediate value for drill-down.

stakeholders.interest: Gets deterministic, explainable results.
Can see how each payslip line was produced.
Can trace each value to its rule pack version.

use_cases.trigger: Pre-payroll audit cleared for the run.
preconditions: The run has no open CRITICAL flag.
The pay component graph for the tenant is acyclic and published.
postconditions_success: Payslip lines and their traces exist for every employee; the run is CALCULATED and payroll.run.calculated is emitted.
postconditions_failure: No partial result is visible; the run stays in PRE_AUDIT with the failing node named.

main_flow.action: Topologically sort the tenant's pay component graph.
Evaluate earnings nodes per employee (basic, DA, HRA, conveyance, special, OT, one-time awards) in integer paise.
Apply attendance-driven proration for LOP days, half days, unpaid absence, joiners and leavers.
Store every intermediate value with its inputs and rule pack version so each line drills to its rule.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee joined or left mid-month.
steps: Proration uses calendar days in the employment span per the component's proration basis.

exception_flows.condition: The component graph contains a cycle.
exception_flows.handling: Calculation stops before any employee is evaluated; the cycle's nodes are named to the payroll manager.

exception_flows.condition: A configured formula would produce a fractional paisa.
exception_flows.handling: The node applies the configured rounding rule and stores the rounding difference as a separate trace value.

exception_flows.condition: Proration of a component across a month boundary does not sum to the full-month value.
exception_flows.handling: The property check fails the run and names the component and employee.

nfrs: Gross-to-net for 10,000 employees completes within 10 minutes.
No floating-point type is used anywhere in the engine (verified by static analysis).

user_stories.want: every payslip line to drill down to its rule and inputs
user_stories.so_that: I can answer any employee query from the screen

acceptance.given: the September run is calculated
acceptance.when: I open an employee's HRA line
acceptance.then: the trace shows the HRA node, its inputs, output and rule pack version

acceptance.given: a component formula references a node that references it back
acceptance.then: it stops before evaluation and names both nodes

user_stories.want: proration to be exact across month boundaries
user_stories.so_that: no paisa is created or lost when a span crosses months

acceptance.given: a joiner on 16 September 2026 with basic of 30,000 rupees
acceptance.then: basic is prorated on 15 of 30 days to 15,000 rupees

acceptance.given: a property test splits a month at every day boundary
acceptance.then: the sum equals the full-month value for every component

use_cases.name: Compute the statutory wage base with the 50% floor
use_cases.goal: Compute one statutory wage base per employee, adding back excluded components above 50% of total remuneration, and publish it to every statutory consumer.

stakeholders.interest: PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus and overtime use a wage base consistent with the Code on Wages (to be validated by Legal).
Can see statutory cost and take-home impact before changing a structure.
Contributions are computed on the correct base.

use_cases.trigger: Calculation of a run reaches the wage base node; or HR runs a structure simulation.
preconditions: Each pay component is classified as wage-base or excluded in the effective rule pack.
postconditions_success: statutory_wage_base is stored once per employee and consumed by PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, OT and encashment nodes.
postconditions_failure: Calculation stops for the employee with the unclassified component named.

main_flow.action: Compute wage_base = basic + DA + retaining allowance.
Test whether excluded components exceed 50% of total remuneration.
Publish statutory_wage_base to the PF, ESI, gratuity, bonus, OT and leave encashment nodes.
Simulate a proposed structure on the salary structure simulator to see statutory cost and take-home impact.

alternate_flows.condition: Excluded components exceed 50% of total remuneration.
steps: The excess over 50% is added back to the wage base; for 60,000 rupees remuneration with 24,000 in basic and DA, 6,000 is added back to give 30,000.
The add-back is stored as its own trace value.

alternate_flows.condition: HR simulates for a population rather than one employee.
steps: The simulator reports aggregate employer statutory cost and the distribution of take-home change; emits payroll.simulation.run.

exception_flows.condition: A component has no wage-base classification in the rule pack.
exception_flows.handling: Calculation stops for affected employees and a CRITICAL flag names the component.

exception_flows.condition: A statutory node attempts to compute its own wage base.
exception_flows.handling: The configuration is rejected; only the single wage base node may be referenced.

nfrs: A single-employee simulation returns within 2 s; a 5,000-employee simulation within 2 minutes.
The wage base node is unit-testable in isolation against the rule pack version.

user_stories.want: the 50% floor add-back to apply automatically
user_stories.so_that: contributions are not understated when allowances are high

acceptance.given: E1014's excluded components exceed 50% of total remuneration in 13_Salary_Structure
acceptance.then: the excess is added back and the wage base trace shows the add-back amount

acceptance.given: an employee's excluded components are exactly 50%
acceptance.then: no add-back is made

user_stories.want: to simulate a new structure before adopting it
user_stories.so_that: I can show statutory cost and take-home effects to management

acceptance.given: E1049's structure is changed in the simulator to raise basic by 5,000 rupees
acceptance.then: the result shows the change in employer PF cost and in monthly take-home

acceptance.given: a simulation has run
acceptance.then: no salary structure has changed

use_cases.name: Compute daily-wage earnings
use_cases.goal: Pay daily-wage classes on days present times the daily rate through a dedicated earnings node, with the day count shown on the payslip.

stakeholders.interest: Can reconcile pay against attendance day by day.
Attendance dispositions drive pay without manual conversion.

use_cases.trigger: Calculation reaches earnings for an employee whose worker class has wage_type daily.
preconditions: The worker class carries wage_type daily and the assignment a daily rate.
postconditions_success: Earnings equal days present × daily rate, and the payslip shows the day count.
postconditions_failure: The employee's calculation stops with a CRITICAL flag naming the missing rate.

main_flow.action: Check whether the worker class has wage_type daily.
Compute earnings = days present (from attendance disposition) × daily rate, with half days at the configured fraction.
Show the day count on the payslip so the worker can reconcile it with the attendance record.

alternate_flows.condition: The worker class is monthly.
steps: The monthly earnings node with attendance proration applies (PAY-04).

exception_flows.condition: No daily rate is recorded on the assignment.
exception_flows.handling: No earnings are computed; a CRITICAL flag blocks approval until the rate is entered.

exception_flows.condition: A daily-wage class is configured to use the monthly node with a proration parameter.
exception_flows.handling: Configuration validation rejects it; daily classes must use the daily node.

nfrs: The payslip day count equals the attendance record's present-day count for 100% of daily-wage workers in reconciliation tests.

user_stories.want: to be paid for the days I was present at my daily rate
user_stories.so_that: I can check my pay against my attendance

acceptance.given: E1032 (WC-CONT) has 24 full days and 2 half days present at a daily rate of 700 rupees
acceptance.then: earnings are 17,500 rupees and the payslip shows 25 paid days

acceptance.given: the same worker
acceptance.then: the earnings line is labelled as daily wages, not as prorated monthly pay

user_stories.want: a missing daily rate to block approval
user_stories.so_that: no daily-wage worker is paid zero by mistake

acceptance.given: a daily-wage assignment has no rate
acceptance.then: a CRITICAL flag names the employee and no earnings line is written

acceptance.given: the rate is entered and the employee recalculated
acceptance.then: the flag is resolved automatically

use_cases.name: Compute statutory deductions and provisions
use_cases.goal: Compute PF, EPS, ESI, PT, LWF and TDS from the central and state rule packs effective for the period, and accrue gratuity and bonus provisions (statutory specifics to be validated by Legal).

stakeholders.interest: Deductions follow the effective central and state packs so returns reconcile.
Deductions and tax projection are correct and explained.
Gratuity and bonus provisions reach the journal monthly.

use_cases.trigger: Calculation reaches the statutory nodes after the wage base is published.
preconditions: Central and state rule packs effective for the period are published.
Each employee's location maps to a state, and the regime choice is recorded or defaulted by the pack.
postconditions_success: Statutory deduction lines and provision lines exist for every employee, each traced to its pack version.
postconditions_failure: Calculation stops for affected employees with the missing pack or input named.

main_flow.action: Evaluate PF and EPS on the statutory wage base against the ceiling in the effective rule pack.
Check whether the employee crossed the ESI wage threshold within the current contribution period.
Evaluate PT from the location's state slab set and LWF from the state schedule.
Evaluate TDS: regime choice, exemptions, perquisites and projection to year end.
Accrue gratuity and bonus provisions on the statutory wage base for the journal.

alternate_flows.condition: Gross wages crossed the ESI threshold mid-period.
steps: ESI continues to be deducted until the end of the contribution period.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee's state does not levy PT.
steps: No PT line is written and the trace records 'not applicable in state'.

alternate_flows.condition: The employee switched tax regime mid-year where the pack permits it.
steps: TDS is reprojected for the remaining months under the new regime, offsetting tax already deducted.

exception_flows.condition: No rule pack version is effective for the period.
exception_flows.handling: Calculation stops for the run and a CRITICAL flag names the missing pack.

exception_flows.condition: No regime choice is recorded.
exception_flows.handling: The default regime defined in the effective pack is applied and the employee is notified (to be validated by Legal).

exception_flows.condition: The location has no state mapping.
exception_flows.handling: PT and LWF are not computed for the employee and a CRITICAL flag names the location.

nfrs: A rule pack change takes effect from its effective date without a code release.
Each statutory line records the pack name and version used.

user_stories.want: PT to follow each location's state slab set on the same run
user_stories.so_that: multi-state entities deduct correctly

acceptance.given: LE-01 in Karnataka and LE-02 in Tamil Nadu are both in the September 2026 run
acceptance.then: PT amounts differ by state and each line cites its state slab set

acceptance.given: an employee works in a state with no PT
acceptance.then: no PT line is written and the trace states 'not applicable in state'

user_stories.want: ESI to continue to the end of the contribution period after my pay rise
user_stories.so_that: my coverage does not stop mid-period

acceptance.given: my gross crosses the ESI threshold from August in a period ending September
acceptance.then: ESI is deducted in both months

acceptance.given: the next contribution period starts
acceptance.then: no ESI is deducted

user_stories.want: my TDS projection to update when I switch regime mid-year
user_stories.so_that: the remaining months deduct the right tax

acceptance.given: I switch regime effective October 2026 where the pack permits
acceptance.then: TDS for October to March is reprojected under the new regime, net of tax already deducted

acceptance.given: I have not recorded a regime
acceptance.then: the pack's default regime is applied and I am notified

use_cases.name: Recover loans, advances and earned wage access
use_cases.goal: Deduct due instalments for loans, advances and earned wage access without breaching the net-pay floor, and report closing outstanding back to the loans module and the GL.

stakeholders.interest: Never receives net pay below the protected floor.
Loan outstanding in the GL equals the loans module.
Sees every reduced or skipped recovery as a flag.

use_cases.trigger: Calculation reaches the recovery nodes.
preconditions: Active loans and advances with instalment schedules exist in the loans module; the net-pay floor is configured.
postconditions_success: Recovery lines are written, outstanding reduced, loan.repayment.posted emitted; closed loans emit loan.closed.
postconditions_failure: No recovery is posted for the employee and the instalment remains due.

main_flow.action: Read active loans and advances for the population from the loans module.
Test whether the instalment would drive net pay below the statutory minimum wage or configured floor.
Write the recovery line, reduce outstanding and stop recovery when the loan closes; emit loan.repayment.posted.
Report closing outstanding to the loans module and the GL; emit loan.closed on closure.

alternate_flows.condition: The instalment would breach the floor.
steps: The instalment is reduced (or skipped) to keep net at the floor; payroll.recovery.reduced is emitted.
The shortfall is carried forward and flagged to the payroll manager.

alternate_flows.condition: Outstanding is less than the scheduled instalment.
steps: Only the outstanding amount is recovered and the loan closes; guarantor release follows in the loans module.

exception_flows.condition: Payroll is asked to create or approve a loan.
exception_flows.handling: The request is refused; origination and eligibility belong to the loans module.

exception_flows.condition: A recovery would produce negative net without a flag.
exception_flows.handling: The invariant check fails the employee's calculation.

nfrs: Closing outstanding reported to the loans module equals the GL balance for 100% of loans at period close.

user_stories.want: loan recovery to stop at the protected net-pay floor
user_stories.so_that: I always receive at least the minimum

acceptance.given: my net before recovery is 14,000 rupees, the floor is 12,000 and the instalment 5,000
acceptance.then: 2,000 rupees is recovered, 3,000 is carried forward and the reduction is flagged

acceptance.given: the next month has no shortfall
acceptance.then: the instalment plus the 3,000 carried forward is recovered up to the floor

user_stories.want: the closing outstanding to be reported back after each run
user_stories.so_that: the GL loan balance agrees with the loans module

acceptance.given: a loan has 2,500 rupees outstanding and a 5,000 instalment
acceptance.then: 2,500 is recovered, outstanding is zero and loan.closed is emitted

acceptance.given: the run is posted
acceptance.when: the loan control account is reconciled
acceptance.then: it equals the loans module total

use_cases.name: Review, approve and disburse a payroll run
use_cases.goal: Take a calculated run through variance review, approval, dual-controlled bank file generation and release, then emit its journal.

stakeholders.interest: Bank file totals are verified out of band before money moves.
Approves only runs with no open CRITICAL flag and full GL mapping.
Is paid on the pay date.

use_cases.trigger: The run reaches CALCULATED.
preconditions: No CRITICAL flag is open; bank details are verified for the population.
postconditions_success: The run is DISBURSED, payroll.run.disbursed emitted, and payroll.journal.ready sent for FIN-03.
postconditions_failure: The run remains at REVIEW or APPROVED with the blocking reason shown; no bank file is released.

main_flow.action: Review variance against the prior period, the exception list and headcount reconciliation on the run cockpit.
Approve the run; approval is blocked if any CRITICAL flag is open or any component lacks a GL mapping.
Generate the bank file and verify its total out of band under dual control before release.
Release the disbursement; emit payroll.run.disbursed.
Emit the run's salary journal to the finance handshake (FIN-03); emit payroll.journal.ready.

alternate_flows.condition: The approver rejects the run.
steps: The run returns to REVIEW or CALCULATED with the approver's comment.

alternate_flows.condition: The out-of-band total does not match the file total.
steps: The file is voided, the run returns to APPROVED and Finance investigates before regenerating.

exception_flows.condition: A pay component has no GL mapping.
exception_flows.handling: Approval is refused with the unmapped component named.

exception_flows.condition: An employee's bank details changed inside the payroll window.
exception_flows.handling: An alert is raised to Finance and the payroll manager before the file is released.

exception_flows.condition: A correction is requested after DISBURSEMENT_PREPARED.
exception_flows.handling: The run is not reopened; the correction is raised as arrears in the next open run.

nfrs: The user who generates the bank file cannot be the user who verifies its total.
Bank files are encrypted at rest and their hash is recorded on the run.

user_stories.want: approval to be blocked while any component is unmapped to the GL
user_stories.so_that: every rupee paid lands in a known account

acceptance.given: a new 'site allowance' component has no GL mapping
acceptance.then: approval is refused and the component is named

acceptance.given: the mapping is added
acceptance.then: the run moves to APPROVED and payroll.run.approved is emitted

user_stories.want: bank file totals to be verified by a second person out of band
user_stories.so_that: a tampered file cannot be released

acceptance.given: I generated the bank file
acceptance.when: I try to verify its total
acceptance.then: verification is refused because a different user must verify

acceptance.given: an employee changed bank account two days before the pay date
acceptance.then: an alert names the employee before release

user_stories.want: variance against the prior period on the review screen
user_stories.so_that: I catch unexpected swings before approval

acceptance.given: net pay for a department rose 18% against August with a 10% threshold
acceptance.then: the department is highlighted with the variance and contributing employees

acceptance.given: headcount is 1,212 and the population is 1,211
acceptance.then: the missing employee is listed with the reason

use_cases.name: Run off-cycle overtime payroll
use_cases.goal: Pay approved overtime in a separate run against the same period, with its own payslip view, bank file and journal.

stakeholders.interest: Sees overtime cost as its own line, not restated salary.
Receives overtime pay on its own date with its own payslip.
Only approved, tagged overtime is paid.

use_cases.trigger: Overtime for the period is approved and tagged to the off-cycle run.
preconditions: The regular run for the period exists; overtime records are approved and tagged.
postconditions_success: An off_cycle_ot run with its own payslip view, bank file and dimensioned journal exists; payroll.journal.ready emitted.
postconditions_failure: The off-cycle run stays in its current state and the regular run is unaffected.

main_flow.action: Create a second run for the same period with run_type off_cycle_ot; emit payroll.run.created.
Pull only the approved overtime records tagged to this run.
Compute OT pay on the statutory wage base and the state multiplier, and apply statutory treatment.
Produce the run's own payslip view, bank file and journal with run type as a dimension; emit payroll.journal.ready.

alternate_flows.condition: An overtime record is approved after the off-cycle run locks inputs.
steps: The record stays untagged and is picked up by the next off-cycle run.

exception_flows.condition: An overtime record is tagged to both the regular and off-cycle runs.
exception_flows.handling: The record is excluded from both and flagged until it carries a single tag.

exception_flows.condition: No state multiplier is defined for the employee's location.
exception_flows.handling: OT is not computed for that employee and a CRITICAL flag names the location.

nfrs: An off-cycle run for 2,000 employees completes calculation within 3 minutes.

user_stories.want: overtime paid in its own run after salary
user_stories.so_that: salary is not held up by overtime approvals

acceptance.given: PR-2026-09-01 is the September regular run paying on 30 September
acceptance.then: it pays on 07 October with its own bank file and journal

acceptance.given: an OT record is tagged to PR-2026-09-02
acceptance.then: the record is not included in the regular run

user_stories.want: the overtime journal dimensioned by run type
user_stories.so_that: overtime cost is reported separately

acceptance.given: PR-2026-09-02 is disbursed
acceptance.then: each line carries run type off_cycle_ot

acceptance.given: both September runs are posted
acceptance.then: salary and overtime appear as separate lines

use_cases.name: Process retro changes as arrears
use_cases.goal: Recompute pay for closed periods affected by a back-dated change, as at the rule version used then, and pay the difference as arrears in the next open run without rewriting closed runs.

stakeholders.interest: Receives back pay for a back-dated revision with each period itemised.
Closed runs stay intact and the arrears are explainable.
Statutory differences (PF, ESI) are captured for the affected periods.

use_cases.trigger: payroll.arrears.requested, or a back-dated salary, attendance or leave change effective inside a closed period.
preconditions: The affected periods' runs are closed with stored snapshots.
A next open run of type regular or arrears exists.
postconditions_success: Arrears lines exist in the next open run, each traced to its originating period; closed runs are unchanged.
postconditions_failure: No arrears line is posted; the request remains queued with the reason shown.

main_flow.action: Receive the back-dated change or payroll.arrears.requested with person, effective date and reason.
Identify every closed run for the person whose period falls on or after the effective date.
Recompute each affected period from its snapshot with the corrected input, using the rule pack version of that period.
Compute the difference per payslip line, including statutory deduction and provision lines.
Post the differences as arrears lines in the next open run, each referencing its original period and run.
Review the arrears lines in the pre-payroll audit of the next open run.
Pay the arrears with the run and show them on the payslip as a separate section by period.

alternate_flows.condition: The difference is negative (an over-payment).
steps: A recovery line is posted instead, subject to the net-pay floor in PAY-08.

exception_flows.condition: A user tries to edit a closed run directly.
exception_flows.handling: The edit is refused; the change must enter as arrears.

exception_flows.condition: The snapshot for an affected period cannot be read.
exception_flows.handling: The arrears request is held and a CRITICAL flag is raised to the payroll manager.

nfrs: Arrears for 12 affected periods per employee compute within 10 s.

user_stories.so_that: closed runs remain exactly as paid

use_cases.name: Roll back a payroll run before disbursement
use_cases.goal: Return a run to an earlier state to correct a defect found before disbursement, with full audit, and refuse rollback once money has moved.

stakeholders.interest: Can fix a defect without creating arrears when money has not moved.
A voided bank file can never be released.
Every rollback has an actor, reason and from/to state.

use_cases.trigger: A defect is found in a run between CALCULATED and DISBURSEMENT_PREPARED.
preconditions: The run is in CALCULATED, REVIEW, APPROVED or DISBURSEMENT_PREPARED.
postconditions_success: The run is in the chosen earlier state, artefacts from later states are voided, and an audit entry records the rollback.
postconditions_failure: The run state is unchanged.

main_flow.action: Select Roll back on the run cockpit and choose the target state the defect requires.
Check the current state is DISBURSEMENT_PREPARED or earlier and the target is an allowed previous state.
Enter the defect description and reason.
Void artefacts produced after the target state (bank file, approval record), keeping them read-only for audit.
Move the run to the target state and record actor, reason and from/to states.
Correct the defect and take the run forward again through audit, calculation and approval.

alternate_flows.condition: The run is in DISBURSEMENT_PREPARED.
steps: Finance is notified that the bank file is voided; any copy held outside the platform must not be released.

alternate_flows.condition: The defect concerns inputs.
steps: The target state is DRAFT; the inputs are unlocked and a new snapshot is taken on re-lock.

exception_flows.condition: The run is DISBURSED or later.
exception_flows.handling: Rollback is refused; the correction must be raised as arrears in the next open run.

exception_flows.condition: The re-approved run has an open CRITICAL flag.
exception_flows.handling: Approval is blocked as for any run.

nfrs: Rollback completes within 30 s and voided bank files can no longer be downloaded.

user_stories.want: to roll an approved run back to review when I find a defect
user_stories.so_that: I correct it before anyone is paid

acceptance.then: the run is CALCULATED, the approval is voided and the audit entry shows my reason

acceptance.given: the September run is DISBURSED
acceptance.then: rollback is refused with the message to raise arrears

user_stories.want: a voided bank file to be impossible to release
user_stories.so_that: no stale file is paid

acceptance.when: the run is rolled back to APPROVED
acceptance.then: the file is marked voided and its download is disabled

acceptance.given: the run is regenerated
acceptance.then: it has a new hash and requires fresh dual-control verification

use_cases.name: Run payroll for another country on a country pack
use_cases.goal: Run payroll for an entity outside India using a versioned country pack of earnings, deductions, taxes, filings and payslip format on the same calculation engine.

stakeholders.interest: Runs non-India entities with the same cockpit, audit and approval controls.
Country statutory rules are versioned and effective-dated.

use_cases.trigger: A legal entity in a new country is onboarded to the tenant.
preconditions: A country pack for the country is published with an effective date.
postconditions_success: The entity's runs calculate with the country pack and produce payslips in the country format.
postconditions_failure: The entity cannot create runs until a pack is bound.

main_flow.action: Bind the entity to the country pack version effective from its first pay period.
Map the entity's pay components to the pack's earnings and deduction nodes.
Validate the combined component graph is acyclic and every component has a GL mapping.
Create, lock and audit a run for the entity as for any run.
Calculate using the country pack nodes in integer minor currency units with traces.
Produce payslips in the pack's format and language and the pack's statutory outputs.

alternate_flows.condition: A new pack version is published mid-year.
steps: Runs for periods on or after its effective date use the new version; earlier periods keep the old one.

exception_flows.condition: A component is unmapped or the graph has a cycle.
exception_flows.handling: Binding is refused with the offending components named.

nfrs: Adding a country pack requires no change to the calculation engine code.

use_cases.name: Declare tax regime and investments with proof verification

postconditions_success: Regime, declarations and verified proof amounts are recorded and TDS is reprojected.
postconditions_failure: The previous declaration stands and TDS is unchanged.

exception_flows.handling: The excess is not accepted and the limit is shown.

use_cases.name: Apply court-ordered deductions
use_cases.goal: Deduct court-ordered amounts in their legal priority order while protecting the employee's minimum net pay (specific statutory limits to be validated by Legal).

stakeholders.interest: Net pay never falls below the protected minimum.
Orders are honoured in the right priority and evidenced.

use_cases.trigger: HR operations receives a court order or attachment against an employee's wages.
preconditions: Deduction priority order and the protected net-pay floor are configured (to be validated by Legal).
postconditions_success: The order deducts each run in priority order until satisfied, with remittance records.
postconditions_failure: The order is recorded but not active; no deduction occurs.

main_flow.action: Record the order: issuing authority, reference, amount or rate, start date and payee, with the order document.
Confirm the order's priority relative to statutory deductions, loans and other orders.
In each run, compute available net after statutory deductions and apply orders in priority order.
Reduce any deduction that would breach the protected net-pay floor and carry the shortfall forward.
Write deduction lines, update the order's balance and raise a payee remittance record.
Close the order when the amount is satisfied and notify HR operations.

alternate_flows.condition: Two orders apply to the same employee.
steps: The higher-priority order is satisfied first; the second takes only what remains above the floor.

exception_flows.condition: No amount is available above the floor.
exception_flows.handling: No deduction is made, the shortfall is carried forward and the payroll manager is flagged.

exception_flows.condition: The order document is missing.
exception_flows.handling: The order cannot be activated.

nfrs: Order documents are visible only to HR operations, the compliance owner and the payroll manager in scope.

user_stories.want: court orders to deduct in priority order without breaching the floor
user_stories.so_that: we comply with the order and protect the employee

use_cases.name: Send change extracts to an external payroll provider
use_cases.goal: For countries without a native pack, send effective-dated employee and pay changes to an external payroll provider and reconcile its acknowledgement and results.

postconditions_success: The extract is acknowledged and provider results are reconciled with no open differences.

Produce the extract with a sequence number and content hash.

Return an acknowledgement with the sequence number and record counts.
Match acknowledgement counts to the extract and mark it acknowledged.
Return period results (gross, deductions, net per employee).
Reconcile results against platform records and resolve differences.

exception_flows.handling: The extract is marked rejected and the differing records listed.

nfrs: Extracts are encrypted in transit and at rest; sequence numbers have no gaps.

use_cases.name: Close the payroll financial year
use_cases.goal: Produce annual employee tax certificates and perquisite statements, reconcile investments, prepare quarterly TDS returns, and lock the financial year with controlled re-open (forms and obligations to be validated by Legal).

stakeholders.interest: Receives Form 16 and Form 12BA on time and correct.
Quarterly 24Q returns reconcile to payroll deductions.
A locked year cannot be changed without a recorded re-open.

use_cases.trigger: Quarter end for 24Q; financial year end for certificates and lock.
preconditions: All runs in the quarter or year are CLOSED; verified proofs are recorded.
postconditions_success: Returns are filed, certificates published to employees and the year locked.
postconditions_failure: The year stays open with the blocking reconciliation item named.

main_flow.action: At quarter end, aggregate TDS deducted per employee and challan details for the quarter.
Review the 24Q return data, resolve mismatches and file it on the statutory portal.
At year end, reconcile declared versus verified investments and TDS deducted per employee.
Generate Form 16 and Form 12BA per employee from the reconciled data.
Approve publication; certificates appear in employee self-service.
Lock the financial year; further changes are refused.
Record the lock with actor and time and block new runs dated in the year.

steps: The Director / approver authorises a re-open with reason; the change is made and the year re-locked, with revised certificates where affected.

exception_flows.condition: Return data has an invalid PAN or challan mismatch.
exception_flows.handling: Filing is blocked and the affected records listed for correction.

exception_flows.condition: TDS deducted differs from the computed annual liability.
exception_flows.handling: The employee is listed for reconciliation before certificates are generated.

nfrs: Certificates for 10,000 employees generate within 30 minutes.
